The child casually reached out to the client, speaking jovially.
孩子一边笑着说，一边随手指了指客户。

They could almost be mistaken for two old pals from a distance.
从远处看，他们几乎会被误以为是两位关系要好的老友。

There are many ways in which the Zwei Association conducts their protection contracts, but proximity protection is the most commonly requested one among them.
可与Zwei协会签订的保护合同样式有很多种，但贴身保护是最常见的一种。

Staying in close proximity to the client, controlling variables in unanticipated circumstances around them.
待在距客户最近的位置，随时应对掌控周围突发的意外情况。

The child had been exclusively taking these contracts for quite some time.
那孩子很久以来一直在专门担任贴身保护的任务。

dataList.title:

Stop right there. Maintain your distance from the VIP.
站住。你离VIP太近了。

dataList.title:

Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
Aw, big guy… What are you so anxious about? This isn't your first day at work, is it?
哈啊……大块头，你在担心些什么？是第一次干这活吗？

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
I don't know how the Zwei work, but this is not how we do things at our office.
我不知道Zwei是如何开展工作的，但我们事务所的办公方式无法容忍这种行为。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 4
Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
Sheesh... If you're going to act that obvious about it, might as well make our client hold a sign that says "I know you're there! Try and get me!"
真是的……如果你表现得这么引人注目，那不就跟让我们的老板举个写着“我知道你们要来袭击我，我准备好了，来做掉我啊！”的标牌一样吗？

The child sighed, puffing a heavy plume of smoke, and continued.
那孩子叹了口气，吐出了一股浓烟，继续说下去。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 4
Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
The best case scenario is where we DON'T have a 'situation'. It's the best of both worlds, right? No fuss, no muss and we still get paid. Free money.
最好的情况就是我们没有任何“情况”发生。不必辛劳，我们仍可以得到报酬。这是两全其美，对不？

呃……在雇主面前说这话是不是有点不太合适？

dataList.content:
Huh? Oh, right. My bad, my bad. Ha ha.

The client was beginning to seem rather worried.
被称为客户的人此刻开始显得忧心忡忡。

The child suddenly raised his leg and kicked the other bodyguard to the ground.

Hey! Easy there, client fella. I'm not stabbing you in the back. I'm...

Before he finished his sentence, numerous blades struck the spot where the bodyguard stood mere moments ago.
他的话还没说完，无数利刃就飞来刺向了那名保镖刚才站着的地方。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 4
Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
...saving the big guy's life. You can thank me later!
……我可是救了他一命啊。大块头大叔，你可以之后再感谢我~

The child nonchalantly threw off his overcoat and stood between the client and the assailants.
孩子说着闲话若无其事地脱掉外套，站在客户和袭击者之间。

At the exact spot where an assailant's blade was striking.
就在袭击者的利刃侵袭之处。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 4
Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
Hyup!
哈呀！

Underneath the overcoat was the "stuffy" navy-hued coat signifying his membership at the Zwei Association...
外套下面是一件“沉闷”的海军蓝色调大衣，象征着他是Zwei协会的成员……

And underneath his glove was his steel prosthetic arm.
他在手套下藏着的钢铁义手显露了出来。

dataList.title:
Zwei Section 4
Zwei协会 4科
dataList.content:
Boy, there's a lot of 'em.

Sparks flew from the Zweihänder that stopped the blade, glimmering brighter than the embers of the child's cigarette. The assailant had swung the blade with such might that, had it struck, it could have more than bisected the client.
比孩子香烟烟头的余烬还要闪亮的火星从抵挡住利刃的双手剑上飞溅而出。袭击者挥刀的力度极大，如果直接击中的话，足以将客户瞬间劈成两半。

But the child easily held his ground.
但那孩子却显得泰然自若。

With his left hand, the child flicked the ashes off his cigarette, as though one hand was more than enough to withstand the strength behind the blade.
孩子用左手弹了弹烟灰，仿佛一只手就足以承受施以利刃上的力量。

And he remarks.
然后他说。
